Release notes

Version 4.2 ships a faster parser and removes the deprecated callback interface. Upgrade notes follow below, together with the list of fixed defects and the known limitations of this release.

Hidden attribute text that a browser never shows.

Assistive-technology hidden text.

Inline display none text. Inline visibility hidden text.

The zero​width space and the soft­hyphen are invisible, and the family emoji 👨‍👩‍👧 keeps its joiners.

Defects fixed in this release include the timer leak in the scheduler, the wrong exit code of the command line tool, and the missing newline at the end of generated files.
